The '''Legislature Building''', alternatively known as the '''Corellian Legislature''', the '''Legislature''', and a variety of other names during various periods of government, was the seat of government on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Located on [[Capitol Square]] in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] of Corellia's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the Legislature Building served as the seat of government for many different types of government&mdash;it served as a house of parliament, a royal council chamber, a corporate boardroom, and the meeting place of the [[Corellian Council]] at different times.
